WITH member_counts AS (
    SELECT link_to_major AS major_id, COUNT(*) AS member_count
    FROM member
    GROUP BY link_to_major
), group_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        major_id,
        member_count,
        CAST(member_count AS REAL) / SUM(member_count) OVER () AS fraction_of_members,
        CAST(member_count AS REAL) / AVG(member_count) OVER () AS ratio_to_average
    FROM member_counts
)
SELECT major_id, member_count, fraction_of_members, ratio_to_average
FROM group_metrics
ORDER BY ratio_to_average DESC
LIMIT 10;
